name: Kamen Rider: Battride War Genesis - Memorial TV Sound Edition
summary: The newest addition to the Kamen Rider series of videogames is about to launch with a frenzy; new features have made this action brawler extremely explosive, especially with a solid nod to all the loyal fans, new and old, who have followed the heroic exploits of Japan's dramatically posing transforming superheroes!
